facts.fact: The AfDB, as reported by Connecting Africa, describes Nigeria's existing national fibre backbone as around 30,000 km, to be extended to about 120,000 km; regions served are not listed.
The AfDB's $200m loan is to deploy 90,000 km of open-access fibre under Project BRIDGE (D-VIBE); open access is stated as the design of the planned build, with no buyers named.

note: AfDB approved a $200m loan in 2026 (year precision, no month given); no contract or works stated, so no building fact.
